verdict.rationale: cfo.ai documents two ways to get model data out. A Page can be downloaded as an Excel workbook with its formulas, and an official MCP server at api.cfo.ai/mcp lets clients read the financial Model (Pages, Tables, Variables). However, the MCP server issues no API keys, and every client must sign in via OAuth as a person, which is a poor fit for unattended warehouse pipelines. No REST/OpenAPI spec was found, and Snowflake and database connections are inbound only. Missing for 10: a documented REST/data export API or warehouse write-back, service/machine credentials for automated pulls, scheduled or bulk export of metrics, forecasts and scenarios, and independent corroboration.
